icons.name: Closed Guard
icons.concept: A trapped white opponent squeezed by two heavy red legs that cross below into a gold ankle-lock knot, the closed-guard leg lock.

icons.name: Butterfly Frame
icons.concept: A bold symmetric open-guard V-frame: red butterfly legs splayed with upturned gold foot hooks framing the controlled space.

icons.name: Guard Cage
icons.concept: Four interlocking red-and-white brackets pinwheel shut around a gold locked core, guard reduced to pure containment.

icons.name: Triangle Lock
icons.concept: Heavy red triangle-choke frame clamping a trapped white arm, gold cinch knot at the apex.

icons.name: Armbar Break
icons.concept: A white arm levered into a hard inverted-V over a red fulcrum block, gold stress wedge marking the break point at the elbow.

icons.name: Seatbelt Choke
icons.concept: Two interlocking red arm-hooks (the rear-naked-choke seatbelt grip) clasped around a white neck column with a gold clasp at the lock.

icons.name: Drive Shot
icons.concept: A red level-change drive-arrow shoots low and penetrates the base of a standing white figure on the mat — the double-leg, with a gold impact spark at contact.

icons.name: Hip Toss
icons.concept: A heavy red rotational sweep-arc flings a white body-block up and over a red pivot fulcrum into a ground-slam zone — the throw rotation, gold launch accent at the apex.

icons.name: Shot & Sprawl
icons.concept: Two opposing brutalist wedges collide head-on — a red shot driving up, a white sprawl dropping down to stuff it — locked on a gold impact seam.

icons.name: Collar Clamp
icons.concept: A heavy red fist clamps a white gi lapel-V, four knuckle bars wrapping over the collar with a gold tension spark at the bite.

icons.name: Two-Grip Cross
icons.concept: Sleeve-and-collar control: two red fists clamp two crossing white gi strips forming an X, gold diamond marking the contested center.

icons.name: Lapel Fist
icons.concept: Frontal emblem of a single brutal red fist gripping a vertical white lapel that runs the full canvas, gold wedge where the grip crushes.

icons.name: Seatbelt
icons.concept: Bold red seatbelt-harness X crossing a defender's torso, locked by a white buckle = the back-control grip.

icons.name: Hooks In
icons.concept: Two heavy red hook-clamps gripping a central torso bar from behind = both hooks inserted, control sealed.

icons.name: Back Take
icons.concept: Stacked two-figure silhouette: a red grappler riding the back of a white defender, gold buckle on the chest.

icons.name: Clinch Pinwheel
icons.concept: Two hook-shaped grappler bodies rotated 180 degrees about a gold lock, spiraling into each other like a clinch caught mid-spin.

icons.name: Locked Halves
icons.concept: Red and white grapplers fused into one tight square block, arms reaching across and meeting at a gold center: two bodies interlocked into a single brutalist mark.

icons.name: Woven Limbs
icons.concept: Two heavy angular limbs sweeping in opposite diagonals, weaving over and under each other into a centered gold-locked knot: chaos of the roll tangled into one form.
